title: DayPlay SF Bay Area Local Intelligence
description: Query DayPlay's verified real-time dataset: places, events, neighborhood centroids, or a fully composed outing itinerary with walk legs. Strictly San Francisco, Oakland, and Berkeley.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: plan = composed multi-stop itinerary with walk times (flagship). events/places = raw verified records. neighborhoods = the 35 in-market centroids.

neighborhood.title: Neighborhood
neighborhood.description: Exact SF Bay Area neighborhood name (e.g. Mission, North Beach, Oakland, Berkeley — see the neighborhoods list at dayplay.io). Out-of-market names are refused by protocol — DayPlay never invents venues.

date.title: Date
date.description: Outing/query date as YYYY-MM-DD. Required for mode=plan and mode=events.

interests.title: Interests
interests.description: Optional comma-separated interests (e.g. music, food, art, comedy) to prioritize in plan mode.

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: Optional budget tier for plan mode.

maxStops.title: Max stops (plan mode)
maxStops.description: Maximum number of stops in a composed itinerary.

limit.title: Record limit (events/places mode)
limit.description: Max records returned in events or places mode.
